title: BatchObservations
description: The deterministic artifact overwritten by `dmtool batch <ops.json> --observations <file>`. It retains static real-kernel candidate outcomes as diagnostic codes only: no summaries, authored inputs, arguments, timings, paths, locale-dependent text, host data, interpreter runtime values, qualification, or projector data. Every child needs an id and must be `rule check --condition ...`, `computation add <spec> --dry-run`, or `computation modify ... --spec <spec> --dry-run`; observation capture never persists a computation candidate. The inputHash is SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 condition string or exact computation-spec file bytes. The optional model is SHA-256 of the one effective persisted model file and is omitted for a heterogeneous/no-model batch. A completed gate may have ok:true with valid:false: ok is execution success; valid is the kernel verdict and appears only when the child emitted one.

schemaVersion.description: integer artifact shape version; bumped only for a breaking shape change

kernelBuilt.description: kernel version built against, exactly manifest.version.kernel.builtAgainst

kernelRuntime.description: kernel version on the runtime classpath, exactly manifest.version.kernel.runtime

model.description: optional SHA-256 of the one effective model's persisted bytes after dispatch; omitted when there is no single model identity

observations.description: one compact result per child in dispatch order

id.description: the caller's batch item tag, verbatim

inputHash.description: SHA-256 over the exact authored condition UTF-8 or computation-spec bytes

ok.description: the child's execution-success axis; independent of valid

valid.description: the child's kernel verdict, present only when the invocation emitted one

codes.description: diagnostic code values in emitted kernel order; never summaries
